paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben Ketzarta: Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:9.
Rabbi Yose ben Ketzarta: Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, chapter 2, halakhah 6.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:9 has Yochanan ben Ketzartah; the Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:6 has Yose bar Ketzartah. Hyman supplies Ketzarta and uses ben in both notices.

The whole Midrash Rabbah TE Shir HaShirim Rabbah paragraph fully writes Rabbi Yochanan ben Ketzartah; the whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:6 paragraph fully writes Rabbi Yose bar Ketzartah. Hyman’s Ketzarta and ben forms remain, and the current note remains verbatim. The separate pointers do not establish one common father or an authority merge.
